title: Still doing Descript by hand?
caption:
Still doing Descript by hand?

Unpopular truth about this:
1️⃣ Drop the recording — Transcript appears in minutes — that plain text is now your editing timeline.
2️⃣ Edit text, cut video — Delete a sentence, the clip goes. Fillers and false starts die with one click, not one scrub.
3️⃣ Pull the clips — Underlord surfaces the moments worth posting — you review candidates instead of hunting timestamps.
4️⃣ One edit, two assets — Clean short from the cut, blog post from the transcript. Same hour, double the output.

Agree or disagree? Weigh in.
